title: Ko‘chirma gap: to‘liq tizim
goal_uz: Dars oxirida hisobot fe’llarini to‘g‘ri naqshlar bilan ishlatasiz, savol, buyruq va taklifni ko‘chirasiz, zamon qachon o‘zgarmasligini bilasiz va suhbatni qisqa xulosa qilib bera olasiz.

scenes.title: Ko‘chirma gap: to‘liq tizim
board: Reported speech: the full system
Verbs, questions, commands, suggestions
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda matnni tez o‘qishning skimming va scanning usullarini o‘rgandik. Bugun boshqa kuchli ko‘nikma: birovning gapini aniq va tabiiy ko‘chirish. Dars oxirida siz hisobot fe’llarining naqshlarini bilasiz, savol, buyruq va taklifni to‘g‘ri ko‘chirasiz, zamon qachon o‘zgarmasligini tushunasiz hamda suhbatni qisqa xulosa qilib bera olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time you learned to read fast. Today you will learn to report what other people said, accurately and naturally.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingiz bilan! O‘tgan safar tez o‘qishni o‘rgandingiz. Bugun boshqa odamlar aytganini aniq va tabiiy ko‘chirishni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Ko‘chirma gap qanday ishlaydi
board: “I am tired,” she said.
She said (that) she was tired.
Reporting clause + reported clause
scenes.say_native: Ko‘chirma gap ikki qismdan iborat: hisobot qismi, masalan “she said”, va ko‘chirilgan qism. O‘zbekchada ko‘chirma gap ko‘pincha zamonni o‘zgartirmaydi, “u charchadim dedi” deymiz. Inglizchada esa hisobot fe’li o‘tgan zamonda bo‘lsa, ko‘chirilgan qismdagi zamon odatda bir pog‘ona orqaga suriladi. Bu backshift deyiladi.
scenes.say: Reported speech has a reporting clause, like she said, and a reported clause. When the reporting verb is in the past, the verb in the reported clause usually moves one step back in time. This is called backshift.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘chirma gap hisobot qismi va ko‘chirilgan qismdan iborat. Hisobot fe’li o‘tgan zamonda bo‘lsa, ko‘chirilgan qismdagi fe’l odatda bir pog‘ona orqaga suriladi. Bunga backshift deyiladi.

scenes.title: Backshift jadvali
board: am/is/are, do -> was/were, did
has done, did -> had done
will, can, may -> would, could, might
must -> had to
scenes.say_native: Jadvalni eslang. Hozirgi oddiy o‘tgan oddiyga o‘tadi: “I work” bu “she worked”. Hozirgi mukammal va o‘tgan oddiy ikkalasi ham o‘tgan mukammalga: “I have finished” va “I finished” bu “she had finished”. Will bu would, can bu could, may bu might. Majburiyat bildiruvchi must esa had to bo‘ladi. “Must” taxmin bildirsa, o‘zgarmaydi.
scenes.say: Present simple becomes past simple. Present perfect and past simple become past perfect. Will, can and may become would, could and might. Must for obligation becomes had to.
scenes.say_uz: Hozirgi oddiy o‘tgan oddiyga o‘tadi. Hozirgi mukammal va o‘tgan oddiy o‘tgan mukammalga o‘tadi. Will, can, may would, could, might bo‘ladi. Majburiyat must had to bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Vaqt va joy so‘zlari
board: now -> then | today -> that day
tomorrow -> the next day | yesterday -> the day before
here -> there | this -> that
last week -> the week before | ago -> before
scenes.say_native: Zamon bilan birga vaqt va joy so‘zlari ham o‘zgaradi, chunki gapni boshqa paytda va boshqa joyda aytyapsiz. Now bu then, today bu that day, tomorrow bu the next day, yesterday bu the day before. Here bu there, this bu that. Last week bu the week before, ago bu before.
scenes.say: Time and place words change too. Now becomes then, tomorrow becomes the next day, yesterday becomes the day before, here becomes there, and ago becomes before. If you report it in the same place and time, you can keep them.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqt va joy so‘zlari ham o‘zgaradi. Now then bo‘ladi, tomorrow the next day, yesterday the day before, here there, ago before. Xuddi shu joy va vaqtda ko‘chirsangiz, o‘zgartirmaslik ham mumkin.

scenes.title: Say va tell, olmosh xatolari
board: ✗ He said me that he was late.
✓ He told me that he was late. / He said that he was late.
✗ She said she is tired (kecha aytgan)
✓ She said she was tired.
scenes.say_native: Uch xato. Birinchi: “said me”. Say dan keyin shaxs kelmaydi, tell dan keyin esa shaxs shart: “told me”. Yoki “said to me”. Ikkinchi: o‘tgan zamondagi hisobot fe’lidan keyin zamonni surmaslik, masalan “she said she is tired”. Uchinchi: olmoshni o‘zgartirmaslik, ya’ni “I” ni hamma vaqt “I” qoldirish.
scenes.say: Do not say said me. After say we do not use a person; after tell we must. Also remember to move the tense back and change the pronouns.
scenes.say_uz: Said me demang. Say dan keyin shaxs kelmaydi, tell dan keyin shaxs shart. Zamonni orqaga surishni va olmoshlarni o‘zgartirishni ham unutmang.

scenes.title: Ko‘chiring
board: 1 “I'm working tomorrow,” Tom said.
2 “We've lost the keys,” they said.
3 “I can't come,” she told me.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni ko‘chirma gapga aylantiring. Birinchi: Tom ertaga ishlayman dedi. Ikkinchi: ular kalitlarni yo‘qotdik dedi. Uchinchi: u kela olmayman deb menga aytdi. Zamon, olmosh va vaqt so‘zini o‘zgartirishni unutmang. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Report these. One: I am working tomorrow, Tom said. Two: We have lost the keys, they said. Three: I cannot come, she told me.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘chiring. Bir: Ertaga ishlayman, dedi Tom. Ikki: Kalitlarni yo‘qotdik, dedi ular. Uch: Kela olmayman, dedi u menga.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 Tom said he was working the next day.
2 They said they had lost the keys.
3 She told me she couldn't come.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: Tom said he was working the next day, bu yerda am working bu was working, tomorrow bu the next day. Ikkinchi: they said they had lost the keys, hozirgi mukammal o‘tgan mukammalga o‘tdi. Uchinchi: she told me she couldn’t come, can’t bu couldn’t. Hammasi jadvalga to‘g‘ri keldi. Endi eng qiziq qism: “said” dan boshqa fe’llar.
scenes.say: Tom said he was working the next day. They said they had lost the keys. She told me she could not come. Now let us look at verbs other than said.
scenes.say_uz: Tom ertasi kuni ishlashini aytdi. Ular kalitlarni yo‘qotganini aytdi. U kela olmasligini menga aytdi. Endi said dan boshqa fe’llarni ko‘ramiz.

scenes.title: Hisobot fe’llari: that bilan
board: verb + (that) clause
admit, claim, complain, explain, mention, point out, suggest, deny

examples.t: She admitted that she was wrong.
He claimed that he had never met her.
examples.uz: U uni hech uchratmaganini da’vo qildi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi naqsh: fe’l, keyin that bilan boshlanuvchi gap. That ko‘pincha tushib qoladi. Bunga admit, claim, complain, explain, mention, point out, add, insist, deny kiradi. Har birining o‘z ohangi bor. Admit tan olish, claim bahsli da’vo qilish, complain shikoyat qilish, point out esa e’tiborni qaratish.
scenes.say: The first pattern is verb plus a that clause. For example: she admitted that she was wrong, he claimed that he had never met her, they complained that the room was cold.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi naqsh: fe’l va that gap. Masalan: u xato qilganini tan oldi, u uni hech qachon uchratmaganini da’vo qildi, ular xona sovuq ekanidan shikoyat qildi.

scenes.title: Fe’l + odam + to-infinitiv
board: advise, ask, invite, order, persuade, remind, tell, warn, encourage + object + to do
negative: not to do

examples.uz: U menga dam olishni maslahat berdi.

examples.t: He told us not to wait.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi naqsh: fe’l, odam va to-infinitiv. Bu buyruq, maslahat, ogohlantirish fe’llari: advise, ask, invite, order, persuade, remind, tell, warn, encourage, urge. Odam albatta kerak: “She advised me to rest.” Inkor esa to dan oldin not bilan: “He told us not to wait.” O‘zbekchada bunday qurilma yo‘q, shuning uchun uni gap shakli sifatida yod oling.
scenes.say: The second pattern is verb plus object plus to infinitive. She advised me to rest. He reminded us to lock the door. The negative is not to: he told us not to wait.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkinchi naqsh: fe’l, obyekt va to-infinitiv. U menga dam olishni maslahat berdi. U bizga eshikni qulflashni eslatdi. Inkor not to: u bizga kutmaslikni aytdi.

scenes.title: Fe’l + to-infinitiv
board: promise, refuse, offer, agree, threaten, demand, decide + to do
He promised to call. / He promised that he would call.

examples.uz: U bizni olib borishni taklif qildi.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi naqsh: odamsiz to-infinitiv. Bunda faqat gapiruvchining o‘z harakati ko‘chiriladi: promise, refuse, offer, agree, threaten, demand, decide. “She refused to help.” “He offered to drive us.” Ko‘p hollarda that gap bilan ham aytish mumkin: “He promised to call” yoki “He promised that he would call.” Ma’nosi bir xil, birinchisi ixchamroq.
scenes.say: The third pattern is verb plus to infinitive, with no object. She refused to help. He offered to drive us. Some of these can also take a that clause: he promised that he would call.
scenes.say_uz: Uchinchi naqsh: obyektsiz to-infinitiv. U yordam berishdan bosh tortdi. U bizni mashinada olib borishni taklif qildi. Ba’zilari that gap bilan ham keladi: u qo‘ng‘iroq qilishga va’da berdi.

scenes.title: Fe’l + -ing va predlog + -ing
board: admit, deny, suggest, recommend, mention + -ing
apologise for, accuse sb of, insist on, thank sb for, congratulate sb on + -ing
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi naqsh: -ing shakli. Admit, deny, suggest, recommend va mention dan keyin to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri -ing keladi: “He denied taking the money.” Boshqa fe’llar predlog talab qiladi, predlogdan keyin ham -ing: apologise for, accuse somebody of, insist on, thank somebody for, congratulate somebody on. “She apologised for being late.” Bu yerda to-infinitiv ishlatib bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: The fourth pattern uses the -ing form. He denied taking the money. Some verbs need a preposition first: she apologised for being late, they accused him of lying, I thanked her for helping.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtinchi naqsh -ing shaklidan foydalanadi. U pulni olganini rad etdi. Ba’zi fe’llar oldin predlog talab qiladi: u kechikkani uchun uzr so‘radi, ular uni yolg‘on gapirishda ayblashdi, men unga yordami uchun rahmat dedim.

scenes.title: Naqsh xatolari
board: ✗ He suggested me to go.
✓ He suggested going. / He suggested that I go.
✗ She apologised me. ✓ She apologised to me.
✗ He explained me the rule. ✓ He explained the rule to me.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “maslahat berdi, tushuntirdi, uzr so‘radi” fe’llari odamni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri qabul qiladi, shuning uchun xato ko‘p. Suggest, explain, apologise, describe, mention dan keyin to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri odam kelmaydi, oldin “to” kerak. Suggest dan keyin “to go” ham bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: We do not say suggested me to go. We say suggested going, or suggested that I go. Also: explained the rule to me, and apologised to me.
scenes.say_uz: Suggested me to go demaymiz. Suggested going yoki suggested that I go deymiz. Shuningdek: qoidani menga tushuntirdi va mendan uzr so‘radi, bu yerda to kerak.

scenes.title: Mos fe’lni tanlang
board: 1 “I'll drive you home.” -> He ... to drive me home.
2 “Don't touch it!” -> She ... me not to touch it.
3 “Sorry I'm late.” -> He ... for being late.
4 “I didn't take it.” -> She ... taking it.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Birinchi: men sizni uyga olib boraman, bu taklif. Ikkinchi: unga tegma, bu ogohlantirish. Uchinchi: kechikkanim uchun kechirasiz, bu uzr. To‘rtinchi: men olmadim, bu rad etish. Mos hisobot fe’lini va shaklini ayting.
scenes.say: Choose the verb. One: I will drive you home. Two: Do not touch it. Three: Sorry I am late. Four: I did not take it.
scenes.say_uz: Fe’lni tanlang. Bir: Sizni uyga olib boraman. Ikki: Unga tegmang. Uch: Kechikkanim uchun kechirasiz. To‘rt: Men uni olmadim.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 offered
2 warned
3 apologised
4 denied
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: he offered to drive me home. Ikkinchi: she warned me not to touch it. Ogohlantirish uchun warned yoki told ham bo‘ladi, lekin warned aniqroq. Uchinchi: he apologised for being late. To‘rtinchi: she denied taking it. Ko‘ryapsizmi, to‘g‘ri fe’l tanlash butun gapni ravshan qiladi, “said” esa hech qachon bunchalik aniq emas.
scenes.say: He offered to drive me home. She warned me not to touch it. He apologised for being late. She denied taking it. A precise verb makes the sentence much clearer than said.
scenes.say_uz: U meni uyga olib borishni taklif qildi. U menga tegmaslikni ogohlantirdi. U kechikkani uchun uzr so‘radi. U uni olganini rad etdi. Aniq fe’l gapni said ga qaraganda ancha ravshan qiladi.

scenes.title: Ko‘chirilgan savollar
board: Yes/no: ask + if / whether
Wh-: ask + question word + statement order
“Where do you live?” -> She asked where I lived.

examples.t: “Do you smoke?” -> He asked if I smoked.
“Where did you go?” -> She asked where I had gone.

scenes.say_native: Savolni ko‘chirganda tartib oddiy darak gapga qaytadi. Inversiya yo‘q, do/does/did yo‘q, so‘roq belgisi ham yo‘q. Yes-no savoli if yoki whether bilan boshlanadi: “She asked if I had finished.” Wh-savol so‘roq so‘zini saqlaydi: “She asked where I lived.” Hisobot fe’llari: asked, wanted to know, wondered.
scenes.say: In reported questions the word order is the same as in a statement. There is no inversion, no do or did, and no question mark. She asked if I had finished. She asked where I lived.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘chirilgan savolda tartib darak gapdagidek. Inversiya yo‘q, do yoki did yo‘q, so‘roq belgisi ham yo‘q. U tugatdingizmi, deb so‘radi. U qayerda yashashimni so‘radi.

scenes.title: Savollarni ko‘chiring
board: 1 “Are you hungry?”
2 “What time does the train leave?”
3 “Did you see the match?”
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolni ko‘chiring, “She asked…” bilan boshlang. Birinchi: ochmisiz. Ikkinchi: poyezd soat nechada jo‘naydi. Uchinchi: o‘yinni ko‘rdingizmi. Tartibga e’tibor bering: so‘roq so‘zidan keyin ega, keyin fe’l, va zamonni orqaga suring.
scenes.say: Report the questions starting with She asked. One: Are you hungry? Two: What time does the train leave? Three: Did you see the match?
scenes.say_uz: Savollarni She asked bilan ko‘chiring. Bir: Ochmisiz? Ikki: Poyezd soat nechada jo‘naydi? Uch: O‘yinni ko‘rdingizmi?

scenes.title: Savollar javobi
board: 1 She asked if I was hungry.
2 She asked what time the train left.
3 She asked if I had seen the match.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: she asked if I was hungry, bu yerda am bu was. Ikkinchi: she asked what time the train left. Does yo‘qoldi, leaves bu left. Uchinchi: she asked if I had seen the match, o‘tgan oddiy o‘tgan mukammalga. Hammasida darak gap tartibi. Xatolarning eng ko‘pi: “she asked what time did the train leave”, uni bundan keyin eshitsangiz, tuzating.
scenes.say: She asked if I was hungry. She asked what time the train left. She asked if I had seen the match. Notice the statement order in each.
scenes.say_uz: U ochmisiz, deb so‘radi. U poyezd soat nechada jo‘nashini so‘radi. U o‘yinni ko‘rganimni so‘radi. Har birida darak gap tartibiga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Savol ko‘chirishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ She asked what time did the train leave.
✓ She asked what time the train left.
✗ He asked me did I like it.
✓ He asked me if I liked it.
scenes.say_native: Ko‘chirilgan savolda eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: asl savoldagi tartibni saqlab qolish. Ya’ni so‘roq so‘zidan keyin did yoki do qo‘yish, yoki yes-no savolida if ni tushirib qoldirish. Ko‘chirmada savol darak gapga aylanadi, shuning uchun yordamchi fe’l ham, so‘roq belgisi ham kerak emas. Yes-no savolida if yoki whether albatta bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Do not keep the question order. Say she asked what time the train left, not what time did the train leave. After a yes or no question, use if or whether.
scenes.say_uz: Savol tartibini saqlamang. Poyezd qachon jo‘nashini so‘radi deng, what time did the train leave demang. Ha yoki yo‘q savolida if yoki whether ishlating.

scenes.title: Buyruq, iltimos va taklif
board: tell/order/ask + object + (not) to do
suggest + -ing / that + subject + (should) + verb
“Let's go!” -> He suggested going.

examples.t: She asked me to open the window.

scenes.say_native: Buyruq va iltimosni ko‘chirishda fe’l, odam va to-infinitiv: “Sit down!” bu “He told me to sit down”. Iltimos asked bilan: “Could you open the window?” bu “She asked me to open the window.” Taklif esa suggest bilan: “Let’s go!” bu “He suggested going” yoki “He suggested that we go”. Rasmiy Britaniya ingliz tilida “should go” ham ishlatiladi: “suggested that we should go”.
scenes.say: Commands and requests use tell, order or ask plus an object and to. Suggestions use suggest: he suggested going, or he suggested that we go. In British English you may also hear that we should go.
scenes.say_uz: Buyruq va iltimoslarda tell, order yoki ask, odam va to ishlatiladi. Takliflarda suggest: u borishni taklif qildi, yoki bizga borishni taklif qildi. Britaniya ingliz tilida that we should go ham uchraydi.

scenes.title: Buyruq va takliflar
board: 1 “Don't be late!” (told)
2 “Why don't we take a taxi?” (suggested)
3 “Could you help me?” (asked)
scenes.say_native: Uch gapni ko‘chiring. Birinchi: kechikma, told bilan. Ikkinchi: taksi olsak-chi, suggested bilan. Uchinchi: menga yordam bera olasizmi, asked bilan. Birinchisida not to, ikkinchisida -ing yoki that gap kerak. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Report these. One: Do not be late, with told. Two: Why do not we take a taxi, with suggested. Three: Could you help me, with asked.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘chiring. Bir: Kechikma, told bilan. Ikki: Taksi olsak-chi, suggested bilan. Uch: Menga yordam bera olasizmi, asked bilan.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1 He told me not to be late.
2 She suggested taking a taxi. / ...that we take a taxi.
3 He asked me to help him.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: he told me not to be late. Not to, ya’ni inkor to dan oldin. Ikkinchi: she suggested taking a taxi yoki she suggested that we take a taxi. Uchinchisi: he asked me to help him. Diqqat: iltimosda “could you” so‘zi tushib qoladi, uni ko‘chirmaymiz, faqat asked + odam + to. Bu jumlani yodlab oling.
scenes.say: He told me not to be late. She suggested taking a taxi, or she suggested that we take a taxi. He asked me to help him. Could you disappears in the report.
scenes.say_uz: U menga kechikmaslikni aytdi. U taksi olishni taklif qildi. U mendan yordam berishni so‘radi. Could you iborasi ko‘chirmada tushib qoladi.

scenes.title: Say, tell, ask: qisqa farq
board: say (+ to) / tell + person
ask + person + if/to
say hello, tell the truth, tell a lie
scenes.say_native: Uchta asosiy fe’l: say, tell va ask. Say dan keyin shaxs to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri kelmaydi, kerak bo‘lsa to bilan: said to me. Tell dan keyin esa shaxs shart: told me. Ask savol yoki iltimos uchun. Ba’zi birikmalar o‘zgarmaydi: say hello, tell the truth, tell a lie, tell a story.
scenes.say: Say is not followed directly by a person, but tell is. Ask is for questions and requests. Some fixed phrases never change: say hello, tell the truth, tell a lie.
scenes.say_uz: Say dan keyin shaxs to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri kelmaydi, tell dan keyin keladi. Ask savol va iltimos uchun. Ba’zi birikmalar o‘zgarmaydi: say hello, tell the truth, tell a lie.

scenes.title: Zamon qachon o‘zgarmaydi
board: Reporting verb in present: She says she's tired.
Still true: He said the Earth goes round the Sun.
Would, could, should, might, ought to: no change
Past perfect: no change
scenes.say_native: Backshift har doim shart emas. Birinchi: hisobot fe’li hozirgi zamonda bo‘lsa, zamon o‘zgarmaydi: “She says she’s tired.” Ikkinchi: gap hozir ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, ixtiyoriy: “He said the Earth goes round the Sun.” Uchinchi: would, could, should, might, ought to allaqachon o‘tgan shaklda. To‘rtinchi: o‘tgan mukammal yana bir pog‘ona orqaga ketmaydi.
scenes.say: Do not backshift when the reporting verb is in the present, as in she says she is tired. You can keep the tense if the information is still true. Would, could, should, might and the past perfect do not change.
scenes.say_uz: Hisobot fe’li hozirgi zamonda bo‘lsa, zamon o‘zgarmaydi. Ma’lumot hali ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lsa, zamonni saqlash mumkin. Would, could, should, might va o‘tgan mukammal o‘zgarmaydi.

scenes.title: Ortiqcha surish
board: ✗ He said he would had finished.
✓ “I had finished.” -> He said he had finished.
✗ She said she shoulded go.
✓ “I should go.” -> She said she should go.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xil xato uchraydi. Birinchisi: ortiqcha surish, ya’ni o‘tgan mukammalni yana o‘zgartirishga urinish, yoki would va should ni qayta o‘tgan shaklga o‘tkazish. Bunday shakl yo‘q, ular o‘zgarmaydi. Ikkinchi: yaqinda aytilgan va hali dolzarb gapda ham surishni aralashtirish. Vaziyatga qarang: ma’lumot hali dolzarbmi?
scenes.say: Do not change would, could, should, might or the past perfect again. I should go becomes she said she should go. I had finished becomes he said he had finished.
scenes.say_uz: Would, could, should, might va o‘tgan mukammalni yana o‘zgartirmang. I should go she said she should go bo‘ladi. I had finished he said he had finished bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Suramizmi?
board: 1 “I'm 25.” (Ali says)
2 “Water boils at 100°C.” (teacher said)
3 “I must leave now.” (she said, obligation)
4 “We could try again.” (he said)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapda zamon suriladimi yoki yo‘qmi, ayting, va ko‘chirma shaklini bering. Birinchisida hisobot fe’li hozirgi. Ikkinchisida fan qonuni. Uchinchisida majburiyat bildiruvchi must. To‘rtinchisida could. Har biri uchun sababni ham qisqa ayting.
scenes.say: Backshift or not? One: Ali says, I am twenty-five. Two: The teacher said, water boils at one hundred degrees. Three: She said, I must leave now. Four: He said, we could try again.
scenes.say_uz: Surasizmi yoki yo‘qmi? Bir: Ali: Men yigirma besh yoshdaman, deydi. Ikki: O‘qituvchi: suv yuz darajada qaynaydi, dedi. Uch: U: hozir ketishim kerak, dedi. To‘rt: U: yana urinib ko‘rsak bo‘ladi, dedi.

scenes.title: Surish javoblari
board: 1 Ali says he is 25. (no change)
2 ...water boils / boiled at 100°C. (optional)
3 She said she had to leave. (must -> had to)
4 He said we could try again. (no change)
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: says dan keyin zamon o‘zgarmaydi, he is 25. Ikkinchi: fan qonuni hali ham to‘g‘ri, shuning uchun boils ham, boiled ham to‘g‘ri, tabiiyrog‘i boils. Uchinchi: majburiyat must bu had to: she said she had to leave. To‘rtinchi: could o‘zgarmaydi. Bu qoidalarni biling: ular ko‘chirma gapdagi xatolarning katta qismini oldini oladi.
scenes.say: Ali says he is twenty-five. Water boils, or boiled, at a hundred degrees. She said she had to leave. He said we could try again.
scenes.say_uz: Ali yigirma besh yoshda ekanini aytyapti. Suv yuz darajada qaynaydi. U ketishi kerakligini aytdi. U yana urinib ko‘rsak bo‘lishini aytdi.

scenes.title: Dialog: ofisda
board: Ms Clarke: Can you finish the report by Friday?
Leo: I haven't started the charts.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash dialogi. Rahbar Ms Clarke xodimi Leo bilan hisobot haqida gaplashyapti. Tinglang va keyin har bir gapni ko‘chirma gap bilan aytib berishga tayyor bo‘ling. Kim nimani so‘radi, nima sababni aytdi, nimani buyurdi va nimaga va’da berdi, shunga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Clarke: Leo, can you finish the report by Friday? Leo: I am afraid I can not. The data arrived late, and I have not started the charts. Clarke: Then I will ask Priya to help you. Please send her the files today. Leo: Thank you. I promise I will check everything twice.
scenes.say_uz: Klark: Leo, hisobotni juma kunigacha tugata olasizmi? Leo: Afsuski, yo‘q. Ma’lumotlar kech keldi va men diagrammalarni boshlamaganman. Klark: Unda Priyadan sizga yordam berishini so‘rayman. Iltimos, fayllarni bugun unga yuboring. Leo: Rahmat. Hamma narsani ikki marta tekshirishga va’da beraman.

scenes.title: Dialogni ko‘chiring
board: 1 What did Ms Clarke ask Leo?
2 What did Leo say about the data and charts?
3 What did she tell him to do?
4 What did Leo promise?
scenes.say_native: Dialogni ko‘chirma gap bilan ayting. Birinchi: Ms Clarke Leodan nimani so‘radi? Ikkinchi: Leo ma’lumotlar va diagrammalar haqida nima dedi? Uchinchi: rahbar unga nima qilishni buyurdi? To‘rtinchi: Leo nimaga va’da berdi? Har bir javobda to‘g‘ri zamon va fe’l naqshini ishlating.
scenes.say: Report the dialogue. What did Ms Clarke ask Leo? What did Leo say about the data and the charts? What did she tell him to do? What did Leo promise?
scenes.say_uz: Dialogni ko‘chiring. Ms Clarke Leodan nimani so‘radi? Leo ma’lumotlar va diagrammalar haqida nima dedi? U unga nima qilishni aytdi? Leo nimaga va’da berdi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
board: 1 She asked him if he could finish the report by Friday.
2 He said the data had arrived late and he hadn't started the charts.
3 She told him to send Priya the files that day.
4 He promised to check everything twice.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: she asked him if he could finish the report by Friday. Ikkinchi: he said the data had arrived late and he hadn’t started the charts, o‘tgan oddiy va hozirgi mukammal ikkalasi o‘tgan mukammalga. Uchinchi: she told him to send Priya the files that day, today bu that day. To‘rtinchi: he promised to check everything twice.
scenes.say: She asked him if he could finish the report by Friday. He said the data had arrived late and he had not started the charts. She told him to send Priya the files that day. He promised to check everything twice.
scenes.say_uz: U undan hisobotni juma kunigacha tugata olishini so‘radi. U ma’lumotlar kech kelganini va diagrammalarni boshlamaganini aytdi. U unga fayllarni o‘sha kuni Priyaga yuborishni aytdi. U hamma narsani ikki marta tekshirishga va’da berdi.

scenes.title: Suhbatni xulosa qilish
board: Don't report word by word
Group ideas: discussed, agreed, disagreed
Use verbs that show function: suggest, object, conclude
scenes.say_native: Suhbatni xulosa qilganda har bir gapni takrorlamaymiz. Fikrlarni guruhlab, funksiyasini beruvchi fe’llardan foydalanamiz: ular mavzuni muhokama qildi, bir qarorga keldi, muhokama qilishdi, rozi bo‘lishmadi. Mana foydali iboralar: “They discussed whether to…”, “They agreed on…”, “She objected that…”, “In the end, they decided to…”.
scenes.say: When you summarise a conversation, do not repeat every sentence. Group the ideas and use verbs that show function: they discussed whether to, they agreed on, she objected that, in the end they decided to.
scenes.say_uz: Suhbatni xulosa qilganda har gapni takrorlamang. G‘oyalarni guruhlang va funksiyani ko‘rsatuvchi fe’llardan foydalaning: they discussed whether to, they agreed on, she objected that, in the end they decided to.

scenes.title: Dialog: ta’til rejasi
board: Sam: Why don't we go to the coast?
Dina: I'd rather go hiking.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Ikki do‘st, Sam va Dina, yozgi ta’tilni rejalashtiryapti. Tinglang va suhbat oxirida nimaga kelishganini ushlang. Keyingi sahnada siz to‘rtta aniq fe’l bilan bu suhbatni xulosa qilasiz: suggested, complained, offered va agreed. Ularning ma’nolarini hozirdan eslang.
scenes.say: Sam: Why do not we go to the coast this summer? Dina: I would rather go hiking. The coast is always so crowded. Sam: I will book a cheap hotel if you agree. Dina: Fine, but let us go in June.
scenes.say_uz: Sem: Bu yoz dengiz bo‘yiga borsak-chi? Dina: Men sayohatga chiqqanni afzal ko‘raman. Dengiz bo‘yi doim juda gavjum. Sem: Rozi bo‘lsang, arzon mehmonxona band qilaman. Dina: Mayli, lekin iyun oyida boraylik.

scenes.title: Xulosa qiling
board: Use: suggested, complained, offered, agreed
Start: Sam suggested going to the coast, but...
scenes.say_native: Dialogni to‘rt fe’l bilan xulosa qiling: suggested, complained, offered, agreed. Boshlang: “Sam suggested going to the coast, but…” Esda tuting: suggest dan keyin -ing, complain dan keyin that gap, offer dan keyin to-infinitiv, agree dan keyin to-infinitiv yoki that gap. Uch-to‘rt gap yetarli.
scenes.say: Summarise the dialogue with suggested, complained, offered and agreed. Begin: Sam suggested going to the coast, but Dina said she would rather go hiking.
scenes.say_uz: Dialogni suggested, complained, offered va agreed bilan xulosa qiling. Boshlang: Sam dengiz bo‘yiga borishni taklif qildi, lekin Dina sayohatga chiqishni afzal ko‘rishini aytdi.

scenes.title: Xulosa namunasi
board: Sam suggested going to the coast, but Dina complained that it was always crowded.
Sam offered to book a cheap hotel, and Dina agreed, but she suggested going in June.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “Sam suggested going to the coast, but Dina complained that it was always crowded. Sam offered to book a cheap hotel, and Dina agreed, but suggested going in June.” Ikki gap, to‘rt fe’l, barcha naqshlar to‘g‘ri. Dina’ning “I’d rather go hiking” gapi qisqartirildi, chunki asosiy ma’no shikoyatda.
scenes.say: Sam suggested going to the coast, but Dina complained that it was always crowded. Sam offered to book a cheap hotel, and Dina agreed, but suggested going in June.
scenes.say_uz: Sam dengiz bo‘yiga borishni taklif qildi, lekin Dina u doim gavjum ekanidan shikoyat qildi. Sam arzon mehmonxona band qilishni taklif qildi va Dina rozi bo‘ldi, lekin iyunda borishni taklif qildi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: ko‘chirma gapda kuchsiz shakllar
board: said that /sed ðət/  (that is weak)
He said he'd come. /hiː sed hiːd kʌm/
told me /ˈtəʊld miː/ -- linked
asked if I'd /ɑːskt ɪf aɪd/
scenes.say_native: Og‘zaki nutqda ko‘chirma gap tez aytiladi. Bog‘lovchi that kuchsiz shaklda: “said that” da that aniq “dat” emas, balki qisqa “ðət”. Had va would qisqarib “d” ga aylanadi: “He said he’d come” da “he’d” uzun “i” bilan tugaydi. Asked va told kabi so‘zlar keyingi so‘z bilan bog‘lanib ketadi: “asked if”.
scenes.say: In speech, that is weak, said that sounds like said thet with a very short vowel. Had and would shorten to d: he said he would come becomes he said he'd come. Words link together: asked if.
scenes.say_uz: Nutqda that kuchsiz bo‘ladi. Had va would d ga qisqaradi: he said he'd come. So‘zlar bir-biriga ulanadi: asked if.

scenes.title: Tabiiy ayting
board: He said that he'd finished.
She told me she'd call.
They asked if I'd seen it.
scenes.say_native: Uch gapni tabiiy tezlikda takrorlang. Kuchsiz that va qisqartmalarga e’tibor bering: he’d finished, she’d call, I’d seen. Hamma so‘zni bir xil urg‘u bilan emas, faqat asosiy so‘zlarni kuchliroq aytasiz: finished, call, seen. Bir necha marta takrorlang va tezlikni oshiring.
scenes.say: Repeat at natural speed. He said that he had finished. She told me she would call. They asked if I had seen it.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiiy tezlikda takrorlang. U tugatganini aytdi. U qo‘ng‘iroq qilishini aytdi. Ular men uni ko‘rganimni so‘rashdi.

scenes.title: Fe’l tanlash ohangni ko‘rsatadi
board: claim = I'm not sure it's true
admit = I did something wrong
point out = neutral fact
insist on = refuses to change
scenes.say_native: Hisobot fe’lini tanlash fikringizni ham bildiradi. Claim bahsli da’voni bildiradi, gap yolg‘on bo‘lishi mumkin: “He claimed he was innocent.” Admit aybni tan olish. Point out neytral va foydali, ayniqsa yozuvda. Insist on, ya’ni turib olish. Say neytral. Yangilik va akademik uslubda bunday fe’llar tabiiy, rasmiyroq esa state va announce.
scenes.say: The reporting verb you choose shows your attitude. Claim suggests that you are not sure it is true. Admit shows that someone did something wrong. Point out is neutral. Insist shows that a person will not change their mind.
scenes.say_uz: Tanlagan hisobot fe’lingiz munosabatingizni bildiradi. Claim gapning to‘g‘riligiga ishonchsizlikni bildiradi. Admit biror xato qilinganini bildiradi. Point out neytral. Insist odam fikridan qaytmasligini bildiradi.

scenes.title: Eng mos fe’l
board: 1 “Actually, the meeting is at 3,” she said. (point out/claim)
2 “Yes, I broke the vase.” (admit/deny)
3 “I'm not going. Never!” (insist/offer)
scenes.say_native: Eng mos fe’lni tanlang. Birinchi: aslida yig‘ilish uchda, neytral eslatish: point out yoki claim? Ikkinchi: ha, vazani men sindirdim, admit yoki deny? Uchinchi: men bormayman, hech qachon, insist yoki offer? Variantlarni ma’nosiga qarab tanlang va butun gapni ayting.
scenes.say: Choose the best verb. One: Actually, the meeting is at three. Point out or claim? Two: Yes, I broke the vase. Admit or deny? Three: I am not going. Never! Insist or offer?
scenes.say_uz: Eng mos fe’lni tanlang. Bir: Aslida yig‘ilish soat uchda. Point out yoki claim? Ikki: Ha, vazani men sindirdim. Admit yoki deny? Uch: Men bormayman. Hech qachon! Insist yoki offer?

scenes.title: Fe’l tanlash javoblari
board: 1 She pointed out that the meeting was at 3.
2 He admitted breaking the vase.
3 She insisted that she wasn't going. / on not going.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: she pointed out that the meeting was at three. Ikkinchi: he admitted breaking the vase. Admit dan keyin -ing ham, that gap ham kelishi mumkin. Uchinchi: she insisted that she wasn’t going. Insist on not going ham to‘g‘ri. Birinchi gapda claim ham grammatik jihatdan to‘g‘ri, lekin u “aslida buni ishonmayman” degan ma’noni qo‘shib yuboradi, shuning uchun point out yaxshiroq.
scenes.say: She pointed out that the meeting was at three. He admitted breaking the vase. She insisted that she was not going. Claim would add doubt to the first sentence.
scenes.say_uz: U yig‘ilish soat uchda ekanini ta’kidladi. U vazani sindirganini tan oldi. U bormasligini turib aytdi. Claim birinchi gapga shubha ma’nosini qo‘shardi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: bahsni ko‘chiring
board: Ali: Uniforms save families money.
Mia: Uniforms limit self-expression.
Ali: I admit they can be boring, but schools should keep them.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Qisqa bahs: Ali forma oilalarga pul tejaydi deydi. Mia forma o‘zini ifoda etishni cheklaydi deydi. Ali formalar zerikarli bo‘lishi mumkinligini tan oladi, lekin maktablar uni saqlashi kerak deydi. Uchta turli hisobot fe’li bilan bahsni ko‘chirib bering, masalan claimed, objected, admitted.
scenes.say: Report this debate with three different reporting verbs. Ali says uniforms save families money. Mia says they limit self-expression. Ali admits they can be boring, but says schools should keep them.
scenes.say_uz: Bahsni uchta turli hisobot fe’li bilan ko‘chiring. Ali formalar oilalarga pul tejaydi deydi. Mia ular o‘zini ifoda etishni cheklaydi deydi. Ali ular zerikarli bo‘lishi mumkinligini tan oladi, lekin maktablar ularni saqlashi kerak deydi.

scenes.title: Bahs namunasi
board: Ali claimed that uniforms saved families money.
Mia objected that they limited self-expression.
Ali admitted that they could be boring but insisted that schools should keep them.
scenes.say_native: Namuna: “Ali claimed that uniforms saved families money. Mia objected that they limited self-expression. Ali admitted that they could be boring but insisted that schools should keep them.” Tekshiring: save saved ga, limit limited ga surildi, can could ga, should o‘zgarmadi. Uchta turli fe’l, bu yerda say bir marta ham ishlatilmadi.
scenes.say: Ali claimed that uniforms saved families money. Mia objected that they limited self-expression. Ali admitted that they could be boring but insisted that schools should keep them.
scenes.say_uz: Ali formalar oilalarga pul tejashini da’vo qildi. Mia ular o‘zini ifoda etishni cheklashini e’tiroz bilan aytdi. Ali ular zerikarli bo‘lishi mumkinligini tan oldi, lekin maktablar ularni saqlashi kerakligini turib aytdi.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Backshift + time/place + pronouns
Patterns: that / obj + to / to / -ing
Questions: if/whether + statement order
No backshift: present reporting, still true, modals
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Zamon bir pog‘ona orqaga suriladi, vaqt, joy va olmosh ham o‘zgaradi. Hisobot fe’llari to‘rt naqshda keladi: that gap, odam va to-infinitiv, to-infinitiv, -ing. Savol darak gap tartibida if yoki whether bilan. Buyruq va iltimos tell yoki ask va to bilan, taklif suggest bilan. Hozirgi hisobot fe’li, hali to‘g‘ri ma’lumot va would, could, should, might da surish yo‘q.
scenes.say: Move the tense back and change time, place and pronouns. Choose the right pattern after each reporting verb. Use statement order in reported questions. Do not backshift after a present reporting verb or with would, could and should.
scenes.say_uz: Zamonni orqaga suring, vaqt, joy va olmoshlarni o‘zgartiring. Har hisobot fe’lidan keyin to‘g‘ri naqshni tanlang. Ko‘chirilgan savolda darak gap tartibini ishlating. Hozirgi hisobot fe’lidan keyin va would, could, should bilan surmang.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: report a debate using 10 different reporting verbs
Check: patterns + backshift
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda, masalan telefon va talabalar yoki shahar transporti haqida ikki kishi o‘rtasidagi bahsni yozing yoki videodan tinglang va uni o‘nta turli hisobot fe’li bilan ko‘chirib bering. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: o‘nta fe’lning har biri to‘g‘ri naqsh bilan, zamon to‘g‘ri surilgan. Keyingi darsda rasmiy va norasmiy xat yozishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to report a debate using ten different reporting verbs, each with the correct pattern. Next time we will write formal and informal letters.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: bahsni o‘nta turli hisobot fe’li bilan ko‘chirish, har biri to‘g‘ri naqsh bilan. Keyingi darsda rasmiy va norasmiy xatlar yozamiz.

homework_uz: Ikki kishi o‘rtasidagi qisqa bahsni (o‘zingiz yozgan yoki ko‘rgan videodagi) o‘nta TURLI hisobot fe’li bilan ko‘chirib yozing: masalan claim, admit, deny, suggest, insist, warn, promise, refuse, point out, complain. Har bir fe’l to‘g‘ri naqsh bilan kelsin va zamon to‘g‘ri surilsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: 10 ta gapning kamida 9 tasi grammatik jihatdan to‘g‘ri, say faqat bir marta ishlatilgan. Keyingi darsda rasmiy va norasmiy xat yozishni o‘rganamiz.

quiz.q: She said, 'I am tired.' Choose the correct report.
options: She said she is tired yesterday.
She said me she was tired.
She said she had be tired.
quiz.why_uz: Said dan keyin am/is was ga suriladi; said me xato.

quiz.q: 'I will call you tomorrow.' -> He said he ... me the next day.
quiz.why_uz: Will would ga, tomorrow the next day ga o‘zgaradi.
Suggest dan keyin -ing yoki that gap; odam + to bo‘lmaydi.

quiz.q: 'Where do you work?' -> She asked me ...
quiz.why_uz: Ko‘chirilgan savolda inversiya yo‘q, zamon suriladi.

quiz.q: 'Don't touch the wires!' -> The engineer ... us ... the wires.

options: She said she was ready last year.
She said she had been ready.
She told me she would be ready.
quiz.why_uz: Hisobot fe’li hozirgi zamonda (says) bo‘lsa, zamon o‘zgarmaydi.

quiz.q: 'I must go now,' she said (obligation). -> She said she ...
quiz.why_uz: Majburiyat must hisobotda had to bo‘ladi.

quiz.q: 'Yes, I took the car.' -> He ... taking the car.
